sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Kyle Maurer previously served as American Fork City’s Finance Director and Finance Officer. This page collects records about his role and council remarks concerning police spending.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: January 2018 minutes identify Maurer as Finance Officer in the attendance list and Finance Director in the discussion. January 2019 minutes also list him as Finance Officer. By June 2020, Anna Montoya is listed in that role; these records do not establish Maurer’s exact departure date.

The compensation table includes American Fork City records for 2017–2020 and records from South Jordan, Midvale, and Herriman. Each row identifies the paying government; compensation from another government is not American Fork City pay.

sections.title: Council Meeting Remarks
descriptions: Summaries of this official’s remarks that materially concern police accountability, oversight, policy, victim services, major operations, or significant resource decisions. Routine ceremonial mentions and general praise are omitted; each entry links to the relevant discussion and official minutes.
